question: Which UV unwrap algorithms exist, and which (if any) may write Gasper's 25×40 positions?

gasper.cut: already a disk; silhouette is the cut; zero seams
gasper.flatten: inverse problem; we embed, we do not flatten

lawfulPosition: offset isolines (parent Explore). Harmonic/BFF starve the W inlets.
lawfulLater: BFF as shade-UV names only, never liveGridXYZ
refused: Liu ARAP-param swapped for Igarashi ARAP
sources: Sawhney & Crane 2017 Boundary First Flattening (TOG, CMU)
